2607.28006.title: MMLDSum-LLM: Multimodal Long-Document Summarization with Visual-Alignment and Keyword-Aware
2607.28006.paper_summary: Multimodal long documents are core carriers of professional knowledge, where critical evidence is sparsely distributed across paragraphs and modalities. This easily causes key information omission and cross-modal hallucinations in summarization by multimodal LLMs. These issues stem from attention drift in long-range dependency modeling and gaps in inter-modal alignment. To address this, we introduce MMLDSum-Bench, a high-quality benchmark for multimodal long-document summarization, covering multiple domains, context-length scales, and visual-textual modality distributions. We further propose MMLDSum-LLM, a reproducible two-stage training framework that combines supervised fine-tuning with visual-alignment weighted loss and keyword-aware weighted loss, followed by GRPO with a multi-objective reward (keyword coverage, image-text alignment, ROUGE, and length control). Extensive experiments on MMLDSum-Bench, comparing against leading closed-source and open-source multimodal models under a unified evaluation protocol - including LLM-as-a-judge scoring, atomic-claim precision/recall, image-text alignment (ITA), and ROUGE - demonstrate that our approach significantly improves key-information coverage and cross-modal consistency.
2607.28006.paper_summary_zh: 多模態長文檔是專業知識的核心載體，其中關鍵證據在段落和模態中稀疏分佈。這容易導致多模態 LLM 在總結時遺漏關鍵信息和跨模態幻覺。這些問題源於長距依賴建模中的注意力漂移和模態間對齊的差距。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了 MMLDSum-Bench，一個高質量的多模態長文檔總結基準，涵蓋多個領域、上下文長度範圍和視覺-文本模態分佈。我們進一步提出了 MMLDSum-LLM，一個可重現的兩階段訓練框架，結合了帶有視覺對齊加權損失和關鍵詞感知加權損失的監督微調，然後是帶有多目標獎勵（關鍵詞覆蓋、圖像-文本對齊、ROUGE 和長度控制）的 GRPO。在 MMLDSum-Bench 上進行的廣泛實驗，與領先的封閉源和開放源多模態模型進行比較，遵循統一的評估協議 - 包括 LLM 作為評判者的評分、原子聲明的精確度/召回率、圖像-文本對齊 (ITA) 和 ROUGE - 顯示我們的方法顯著提高了關鍵信息的覆蓋率和跨模態的一致性。
